from collections import defaultdict
def shapes(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==c and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((c,cells))
    return out

def f(g):
    sh=shapes(g)
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in sh: groups[c].append(cells)
    # order groups by total size ascending
    order=sorted(groups, key=lambda c: sum(len(s) for s in groups[c]))
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]
    col=0; H=len(g)
    for c in order:
        ss=sorted(groups[c], key=len)  # ascending
        widths=[]
        placed=[]
        for s in ss:
            ys=[y for y,x in s]; xs=[x for y,x in s]
            norm=[(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in s]
            bw=max(x for y,x in norm)+1; bh=max(y for y,x in norm)+1
            placed.append((norm,bw,bh))
            widths.append(bw)
        gw=max(widths)
        # stack from bottom: shapes ascending, gap row between
        row=H
        for k in range(len(placed)-1,-1,-1):
            norm,bw,bh=placed[k]
            row-=bh
            for y,x in norm: out[row+y][col+x]=c
            row-=1  # gap
        col+=gw+1
    return out
